provenance.tool: Sound Equalization and Correction System 2 (SECS 2) Beta 1.1.0, Speaker Gallery (DCinside), GPL-3.0
provenance.how: secs.correction_engine.CorrectionEngine(...).compute() run unmodified as a black box on the IRs below; only derived numbers are stored, no SECS code
provenance.configuration: mains = the listed speakers, no subwoofers, no crossover; positions = ear positions in order (position 1 is SECS listening position); main_weight sets SECS MAIN_WEIGHT and MAIN_WEIGHT_LO; modes from SECS MODES, ultra-<ms> from its ultra mode; target flat (0 dB) or the demo room-target.csv interpolated linearly in Hz with end values held

ir.construction: Hrir::open_recording_samples(estimator, fs, tracks, speakers, side, 2.0); uncropped split IR (391270 samples)

fields.mag_db: 20*log10(|F|+1e-12) of the channel correction (FIR and PEQ) at bins
fields.design_db: SECS design curve at bins (single-point entries only)
fields.peq_fits: every PEQ fit in call order (single-speaker entries)
